claim: The demo opens with a ready purchase order, and reset restores the original sample.
where: landing sample action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; alter NB-1047, reset, then assert all three original lines and quantities

claim: Compares each received count with the purchase order.
sandbox: fresh demo NB-1047; enter 120, 46, and 24 and assert matched, 2 short, and matched quantity outcomes

claim: Converts 4 cases of 12 into exactly 48 each.
where: NB-1047 belt line and quantity detail
sandbox: fresh demo NB-1047; assert 4 × 12 displays and computes as decimal 48 with no binary rounding residue

claim: Records short and damaged items in one partial-delivery discrepancy.
sandbox: fresh demo NB-1047; receive 46 belts and mark one of 24 seals damaged; finalize and assert both facts in one case

claim: A finalized receipt is corrected with a new event instead of rewriting its history.
sandbox: finalize demo receipt, record a correction, then assert original event and hash remain and a linked correction event is appended

claim: Exports the finalized receipt as CSV.
where: landing facts and receipt export action
sandbox: finalized demo receipt; download and parse CSV, assert versioned headers, three line rows, decimal values, and discrepancy fields

claim: Keeps demo counts through a network drop after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh context; load demo and wait for service worker, set browser offline, change counts, reload, and assert shell, sample, and changes remain

claim: Demo changes stay in the demo sandbox and are not sent to an external service.
sandbox: record all requests during full demo flow and assert same-origin only; inspect opened storage names and assert only intake-desk:demo:v1

claim: Accepts a keyboard scanner code or a typed item code without camera access.
where: receive scan field and compatibility note
sandbox: fresh demo NB-1047; deny camera, send a keyboard-wedge burst for BRG-6204, type BLT-A42 manually, and assert both lines receive focus

claim: Finalized receipts, discrepancies, and audit text use the receiver's current counts.
where: finalization bar, confirmation, receipt, discrepancy, audit history
sandbox: fresh demo; change every seed discrepancy to matched, finalize, then assert no seed shortage or damage appears

claim: Receipt CSV keeps decimal quantity differences exact.
sandbox: fresh demo; receive 46.1 against 48, finalize, download CSV, and assert the difference is -1.9

claim: A receipt cannot finalize when damaged quantity is greater than received quantity.
sandbox: fresh demo; enter received 1 and damaged 2, attempt finalization, and assert the dialog stays closed with a focused error

claim: Imports a real purchase-order CSV and keeps attached photo or PDF evidence with its receipt on this device.
where: landing, import workspace, evidence tray, README
sandbox: fresh browser; import a customer CSV, verify exact case conversion, attach evidence, finalize, and assert only the separate workspace database and same-origin traffic

claim: Importing another purchase order keeps earlier finalized receipts available.
where: real workspace purchase-order inbox and receipt history
sandbox: fresh workspace; import and finalize PO-220, import PO-221, open the inbox, and open the retained PO-220 receipt

claim: Dock costs $49 USD per site each month and starts at Sociobot checkout.
where: landing Dock plan and purchase restore form
sandbox: fresh landing page; assert $49 recurring price, exact Sociobot checkout URL, and local license restore message

claim: Scans a supported QR or barcode from a phone camera into the matching receipt line.
sandbox: fresh demo with a recorded BarcodeDetector/camera fixture; decode BRG-6204 and assert the matching count receives focus
